title: Holiday Events
body:
Syntax: use egg | use present | use <candy> | ask santa present | eat turkey | sell feather | ask uncle sam gifts

Description: During the Monday through Sunday week ending on Easter, every ordinary defeated mob leaves a Painted Easter Egg in its corpse. Use an egg to discover candy. Candy restores Health, Chakra, or Stamina and grants +10% experience from mob kills for 15 real minutes; the perk does not stack.

On U.S. Thanksgiving Thursday through Sunday, two turkeys appear in each built area. A killed turkey is replaced after 15 minutes. Its corpse carries roasted turkey and two feathers. Eat turkey to restore up to 100 each of Health, Chakra, and Stamina and receive +10% mob experience for 30 minutes. Any shopkeeper buys a feather for 500 ryo.

On July 4, Uncle Sam visits every Kage chamber. Ask Uncle Sam about gifts for one box of fireworks, one Bomb Pop Popsicle, and one BBQ Platter per character per year. Use fireworks to light a colorful display; eat popsicle restores up to 60 Chakra and Stamina, and eat BBQ restores up to 100 Health and Stamina.

From December 24 through 31, a Christmas tree and Santa appear in every Kage chamber. Ask Santa about a present (or say 'present') for one wrapped present per character per year. Use present to open it. Holiday dates follow Detroit time; gifts and food remain usable after the event.

Date: 2026-09-29
